info.description: Routes are grouped by audience. Customer app developers should use sections prefixed "Customer App" and "Audience: Public / Customer App". Administrative and staff operations declare their required roles in their Audience tag and x-required-roles metadata.

roleId.description: Role ID associated with the user (UUID v4)

permissionIds.description: List of permission IDs (array of UUID v4)

feature.description: Feature name (e.g., users, projects, tasks, client-notes)

actions.description: Actions to assign for this feature

assignmentAction.description: How to apply these permissions to the user

name.description: The unique name of the role
The new unique name of the role

description.description: The new description for the role

password.description: Password of the user. Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

fullName.description: Full name of the user (only letters and spaces allowed)

email.description: User email address used for login

idToken.description: The identity token returned by Google or Apple

fullName.description: Name supplied on first sign-in (especially for Apple, which only supplies it once)

action.description: Action to apply for these permissions
